Scale: the plate is a square-ish dish, about 22 cm across (a side to dinner plate size), and it spans roughly 350 px, so about 0.063 cm per px.

The rice pile is about 140 px wide by 120 px tall, which is roughly 9 cm by 7.5 cm. It is mounded about 1.5 cm high. That gives a volume of about 0.5 × 9 × 7.5 × 1.5 ≈ 50 ml. Cooked rice packs at about 0.7 g/ml in loose piles, so the pile is about 35 g. The scattered grains around it add roughly 5 g, for about 40 g of cooked rice in total.

There are also faint yellow oil or sauce stains, which add only a negligible amount, perhaps 2 g. A tiny red piece, possibly chili, is about 1 g.
